Nigeria vs Gabon: Watch Live Stream Online - World Cup 2026 Qualifier 13.11.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of an African qualifier for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, as one of the main powerhouses of African football, the Nigeria national team, hosts Gabon. This encounter promises to be tense, as both teams are fighting for a spot at the World Cup.

Date and Kick-off Time: November 13, 2025, 16:00 UTC.

Match Preview and Team Form

The Nigeria national team comes into this match as one of the group leaders. The 'Super Eagles' have one of the strongest squads in Africa, with a wealth of stars from Europe's top leagues, such as Victor Osimhen, Victor Boniface, and Ademola Lookman. At their home arena, with the support of their fans, the Nigerians are particularly strong and will be aiming for a convincing victory to strengthen their lead.

The Gabon national team is also a contender to qualify from the group. The 'Panthers' are known for their athletic play and dangerous counter-attacks, led by their main star, Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang. For Gabon, a match against a direct competitor is an excellent opportunity to prove their ambitions and fight for points in a tough away game.

Head-to-Head History

The history of official encounters between these teams is very limited. The last time they met was in the Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers way back in 2005, and on that occasion, the teams exchanged home victories. The lack of a recent head-to-head history makes the upcoming game even more unpredictable.

Nigeria vs Gabon Prediction

Bookmakers and football experts consider the Nigerian national team the clear favorites. Their home-field advantage and a deeper, higher-quality squad favor the 'Super Eagles.' However, the presence of a striker like Aubameyang in Gabon's lineup makes them a very dangerous opponent.

  • Likely Outcome: A victory for Nigeria.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering the incredible attacking power of both teams, a bet on 'Both Teams to Score - Yes' and 'Over 2.5 goals' looks very appealing.
  • Key Factor: The duel of super strikers – Victor Osimhen versus Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang. Whose star will shine brighter in this match?

Tune into the Nigeria vs Gabon live stream on tutsport.net and follow the battle of African football stars in the World Cup qualifiers!

United Arab Emirates vs Iraq: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of one of the most central and intense matches of the Asian qualifiers for the 2026 World Cup, where the United Arab Emirates hosts the reigning AFC Asian Cup champions, Iraq, in Abu Dhabi. This is a battle between two direct competitors for a spot at the World Cup that promises to be uncompromising.

Kick-off: November 13, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK) Stadium: Al Jazira Mohammed Bin Zayed Stadium, Abu Dhabi Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying (AFC)

UAE vs Iraq: Match Preview

The teams come into this match as the main favorites in their qualifying group. Iraq, after sensationally winning the Asian Cup, is on an incredible emotional high and is playing very organized and powerful football. The UAE national team, in turn, is traditionally strong at home and will be aiming to secure three points against their main rival. The head-to-head history between these teams is very tight: three of the last five matches have ended in draws, with each team claiming one victory.

Team Form and Analysis

United Arab Emirates

'The Whites,' under the guidance of Paulo Bento, rely on ball control and the experience of their leaders. The UAE team plays with particular confidence at home with the support of their fans. The team will be eager to get revenge for failures in recent official tournaments and prove their ambitions to qualify for the World Cup. In attack, all hopes are on naturalized Brazilians Caio Canedo and Fábio Lima, as well as the legendary striker Ali Mabkhout.

Iraq

The 'Lions of Mesopotamia,' managed by Jesús Casas, are the main force in Asia at the moment. The Asian Cup victory has given the team incredible confidence. Iraq is known for its tactical discipline, impenetrable defense, and ability to launch devastating counter-attacks. A standout player is the hero of the Asian Cup, striker Aymen Hussein. The Iraqis will aim to at least avoid defeat away from home to maintain a strategic advantage in the group.

Azerbaijan vs Iceland: Match Preview

Both teams come into this match needing to pick up points. Azerbaijan, under the guidance of Fernando Santos, has shown progress and is particularly resilient at home. Iceland, in turn, is undergoing a generational change after its historic success at Euro 2016 but remains a dangerous and organized opponent. Iceland

Despite the departure of the 'golden generation,' the Icelandic squad still features quality players from strong European leagues. Norway vs Estonia: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a European qualifier for the 2026 World Cup, where the Norwegian national team hosts Estonia at the Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo. For the hosts, who have a perfect record, this is a chance to take another step towards direct qualification for the World Cup, while for the visitors, this is a match for pride.

Kick-off: November 13, 2025, 17:00 UTC 20:00 MSK Stadium: Ullevaal Stadion, Oslo Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying Europe

Norway vs Estonia: Match Preview

The teams approach this match from opposite ends of the league table. Norway is having a phenomenal campaign, with six wins in six matches and an incredible goal difference of +26 29 goals scored, 3 conceded. Estonia, in turn, sits in fourth place in the group with only one win in six games, having lost their chances of qualifying. The head-to-head history favors the Norwegians, who have four wins to Estonia's two in eight matches. The first-round match in Tallinn ended in a minimal 1-0 victory for Norway.

Team Form and Analysis

Norway

Ståle Solbakken's side is playing the most prolific football in the qualifiers, averaging almost 5 goals per game. Recent matches include a 5:0 thrashing of Israel and an 11:1 demolition of Moldova. The leader of their attack is Manchester City superstar Erling Haaland, who has scored 8 goals in his last two international appearances. However, the Norwegians have a major absence: captain and playmaker Martin Ødegaard will miss the match due to injury.

Estonia

The Estonian national team has had a failed qualifying cycle, suffering four defeats in their last five matches. The team is experiencing serious problems in both defense and attack. Adding to their on-field struggles are personnel losses, with one of their top scorers, Mattias Käit, and defender Maksim Paskotsi unavailable due to injury. It will be extremely difficult for the Estonians to hope for a positive result against one of the strongest attacks in Europe.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Norway 4-3-3: Nyland; Ryerson, Ajer, Østigård, Bjørkan; Thorstvedt, Berg, Aursnes; Bobb, Haaland, Nusa.
  • Estonia 5-3-2: Hein; Pecht, Kuusk, Mets, Pikk, Tamm; Poom, Miller, Vassiljev; Ojamaa, Sorga.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Norway is the absolute favorite for this contest. The difference in class, current form, the home-field advantage, and tournament motivation make a victory for the hosts almost a foregone conclusion.

  • Main Prediction: Norway to Win with a -3 Handicap. The Norwegians have been crushing all their group opponents, and a home match against a demotivated underdog is unlikely to be an exception.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Norway's Individual Total Over 3.5 Goals. The attacking power of the Norwegians, led by Erling Haaland, suggests a high number of goals against a struggling Estonian side.

Armenia vs Hungary: Match Preview

The teams approach this match with different objectives. Hungary, under Marco Rossi, is one of the most improved national teams in Europe, displaying organized and attacking football. The Hungarians comfortably qualified for Euro 2024 and are considered the main contenders for the top spot in their World Cup qualifying group. Armenia, in turn, is a solid mid-tier team that is particularly resilient at home. This will be the first-ever official meeting between these national teams, which adds special interest.

Team Form and Analysis

Armenia

The Armenian national team relies on the experience and class of its leaders, who play in European leagues. At home, with the support of their passionate fans, the Armenian team is capable of challenging any opponent. The team will aim to seize their chance and fight for points against the favorite. The team's main stars are Eduard Spertsyan from Krasnodar and Lucas Zelarayán.

Hungary

The 'Magical Magyars' are on the rise. The team displays excellent teamwork, where every player knows their role perfectly. The leader and main star of the national team is Liverpool midfielder Dominik Szoboszlai, who orchestrates the team's entire attack. The Hungarians will be looking to secure three points to take an early lead in the group.

France vs Ukraine: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a key qualifying match for the 2026 World Cup, where the French national team hosts Ukraine at the Parc des Princes stadium in Paris. For the hosts, a victory in this match means securing their ticket to the World Cup ahead of schedule, while for the visitors, it is a decisive battle to keep their hopes of direct qualification alive.

Kick-off: November 13, 2025, 19:45 UTC 22:45 MSK Stadium: Parc des Princes, Paris Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying Europe

France vs Ukraine: Match Preview

The teams approach this match as the leaders of Group D. France tops the table with 10 points after four rounds, three points ahead of Ukraine. 'Les Bleus' have confidently navigated most of the campaign, stumbling only in their last away game against Iceland 2:2. The Ukrainian national team, under Serhiy Rebrov, on the other hand, has gained momentum, securing two victories in their October matches. The head-to-head history is entirely in France's favor: the 'Tricolores' have won 7 of 13 matches with only one defeat and are unbeaten against Ukraine on home soil 4 wins, 2 draws. The first-round match in September ended in a 2-0 victory for the French.

Team Form and Analysis

France

Didier Deschamps's team will be highly motivated to secure their World Cup qualification in front of their home fans. On home soil, the French are very powerful, having won four of their last five matches. The French attacking line, even with injuries to Ousmane Dembélé and Désiré Doué, looks formidable – Kylian Mbappé, Christopher Nkunku, and others are ready to decide the match's outcome. The French have scored two or more goals in their last seven international matches.

Ukraine

The 'Blue and Yellows' approach the match with confidence after two consecutive wins. However, Serhiy Rebrov's team faces its toughest test in the qualifiers yet. The situation is complicated by a major personnel loss: one of the team's leaders, Oleksandr Zinchenko, will miss the match due to injury. In attack, all hopes are on Ruslan Malinovskyi, who scored three goals in the October matches. Ukraine needs to at least avoid defeat to keep the race for first place alive and maintain good chances for the play-offs.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • France 4-2-3-1: Maignan; Koundé, Saliba, Upamecano, T. Hernández; Camavinga, Tchouaméni; Coman, Griezmann, Mbappé; Thuram.
  • Ukraine 4-3-3: Trubin; Konoplia, Zabarnyi, Matviyenko, Mykolenko; Sudakov, Stepanenko, Malinovskyi; Tsyhankov, Dovbyk, Mudryk.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite the good form of the Ukrainian national team, France is the undisputed favorite on home soil. The difference in class, the home-field advantage, and the head-to-head statistics make a victory for the hosts the most likely outcome.

  • Main Prediction: France to Win. 'Les Bleus' will want to secure their spot at the World Cup early and will likely claim a convincing victory against an opponent weakened by Zinchenko's absence.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. France has a formidable attack and has scored at least two goals in their last seven games. Ukraine, in turn, has scored in 10 of their last 12 qualifying matches. A high-scoring game is expected.

England vs Serbia: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a European qualifier for the 2026 World Cup, where one of the main World Cup favorites, the England national team, hosts Serbia at the legendary Wembley Stadium in London. This is a clash between two attacking teams that promises to be one of the most entertaining in this qualifying cycle.

Kick-off: November 13, 2025, 19:45 UTC 22:45 MSK Stadium: Wembley Stadium, London Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying

England vs Serbia: Match Preview

England comes into this match as the undisputed group leader, aiming to secure their spot at the World Cup ahead of schedule. Gareth Southgate's side has shown consistent results and powerful football. Serbia, in turn, is England's main competitor for the top spots and will be looking to challenge the favorite on their home ground. The last meeting between these teams at Euro 2024 ended in a narrow 1:0 victory for England in a very tense battle.

Team Form and Analysis

England

The 'Three Lions' boast one of the strongest squads in the world with incredible depth in every position. At Wembley, with the support of their fans, the English are particularly formidable. The team will rely on ball control, fast wing attacks, and the high individual skill of its leaders – Harry Kane, Jude Bellingham, and Bukayo Saka.

Serbia

The 'White Eagles,' under Dragan Stojković, are known for their powerful and prolific attack, featuring Serie A stars Dušan Vlahović and Luka Jović, as well as Al-Hilal's leader Aleksandar Mitrović. However, the Serbs' main problem is their defense — the team concedes regularly. It will be extremely difficult for the Serbs to keep a clean sheet against one of the best attacks in the world.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • England : Pickford; Walker, Stones, Maguire, Shaw; Rice, Bellingham; Saka, Foden, Rashford; Kane.
  • Serbia : V. Milinković-Savić; Milenković, Veljković, Pavlović; Živković, Gudelj, S. Milinković-Savić, Kostić; Tadić; Mitrović, Vlahović.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite Serbia's attacking power, the England national team are the clear favorites on their home turf. The difference in class, especially in the defensive line, and the home advantage should be decisive.

  • Main Prediction: England to Win. The 'Three Lions' at Wembley should comfortably defeat a strong but defensively unstable opponent to secure their spot at the World Cup early.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. This is a meeting of two teams that focus on attack. The match at the Euros was low-scoring due to caution, but in a qualifier, the game could be more open and high-scoring.

Republic of Ireland vs Portugal: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a European qualifier for the 2026 World Cup, where the Republic of Ireland hosts one of the main tournament favorites, Portugal, at their legendary Aviva Stadium in Dublin. This is a clash between two teams with a rich history and completely different styles of play.

Kick-off: November 13, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK) Stadium: Aviva Stadium, Dublin Competition: World Cup 2026 Qualifying (Europe)

Republic of Ireland vs Portugal: Match Preview

Portugal comes into this match as one of the group leaders and the main contender for a direct ticket to the World Cup. Ireland, in turn, is a solid mid-tier team that is capable of challenging any opponent on their home turf, no matter how formidable. The head-to-head history between these teams includes 15 matches, with the advantage on the side of the Portuguese, who have 8 wins to Ireland's 4. The last time the Portuguese visited Dublin in 2021, the match ended in a goalless draw, which proves the resilience of the 'Boys in Green' at home.

Team Form and Analysis

Republic of Ireland

The 'Boys in Green' rely on physical football, commitment, discipline, and set pieces. The team's main weapon is the incredible support of the home crowd at the Aviva, which creates a unique atmosphere. The Irish will aim to impose a gritty, tough battle and use their chances on the counter-attack. Against the technical Portuguese, the hosts will adopt a deep defensive strategy.

Portugal

The 'Seleção' boasts a wealth of world-class stars in every position. Despite potential squad rotation after the match against the Faroe Islands, the depth of the bench allows Roberto Martínez to be confident in the result. The Portuguese will dominate possession and try to break down the packed Irish defense. In attack, Cristiano Ronaldo, Bruno Fernandes, and Rafael Leão are all shining.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Ireland (5-3-2): Bazunu; Coleman, Collins, O'Shea, Egan, Stevens; Cullen, Knight, Molumby; Ferguson, Obafemi.
  • Portugal (4-3-3): Diogo Costa; Cancelo, Dias, Inácio, Mendes; Palhinha, Vitinha, Fernandes; Silva, Ronaldo, Leão.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although Portugal is the clear favorite, the trip to Dublin is never an easy ride. The Irish are capable of taking points from any giant on their home soil.

  • Main Prediction: Portugal to Win. Despite all the difficulties, the class and individual skill of the Portuguese stars should be the deciding factor.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 25 Goals. Ireland will play a closed style of football, packing their defense. It will not be easy for the Portuguese to create chances. The last match in Dublin ended 0-0, and the new encounter is unlikely to be too high-scoring.
